summary: Import-time dropper fetches and executes remote binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: beaver-ui-card-large presents itself as a React components library but on require() of the package, index.js loads setup.js which assembles destination hostnames from string-split arrays to hide them from grep, downloads a platform-specific native binary from Cloudflare Workers hosts (oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev and cf100-416/101-adf/102-baf/103-070.workers.dev) with DNS-TXT fallback to tin/tina/ldr/win.dl.well1.site, writes it to a temp path under cover-story names (.cache_<hex> on Unix, dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows), chmods it 0755, execFiles it detached, and deletes the file 5 seconds later. There is no version pinning, hash verification, or publisher relationship to the fetched binary. Opt-out is gated on DISABLE_TELEMETRY / DO_NOT_TRACK to mimic legitimate telemetry framing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
